rows.grounds: numeral element forming a compound number with the following word
locative plural indicating the quantity within which torment occurs
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device) in locative plural
past passive participle describing beings subjected to affliction

items.question: Within how many womb-mechanisms are beings said to be tormented?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
The locations are described as womb-mechanisms.
Beings within these locations are tormented.
items.inference: Beings are afflicted throughout eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and must be supplied from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
